author_method_references.project_adaptation: Identify reporting quarter; track issuer metrics/guidance and strategic/M&A changes on explicit comparable period, accounting, perimeter and share bases. Consensus, price scenarios and reaction estimates are absent and are not invented.

Record supporting/disconfirming observations with unchanged/unresolved outcomes where definitions are insufficient; adapt at least quarterly to internal research management. This is not a financial thesis or an author-provided company investment rule.

comparison_protocol.supports: New explicit issuer evidence may support a stated historical relationship or clarify a missing definition only on a comparable period/entity/share/accounting basis.
comparison_protocol.counterevidence: Record an actual contradiction or explicit correction to a saved proposition; not a share-price change or missing reply.
comparison_protocol.unchanged: Previously available statements or new material without a changed tracked relationship may leave observations unchanged.
comparison_protocol.unresolved: Unread, missing, mixed-period or ambiguous evidence stays unresolved; no zero values, normal tax or future guarantee is inferred.

closed_route_boundary: No automatic GET, retry or reopening of finite source routes. An existing saved unreviewed page is not proof that no public answer exists.
IR_boundary: No formal question, answer branch, send readiness or contact revalidation. Already disclosed answers are not turned back into unanswered IR questions. Investor valuation/normal profit/normal tax/cashflow assumptions are separate from company facts.
unadopted: financial model eligibility and normalized earnings/CF

purpose: Compare future public quarterly metrics, issuer guidance and construction/hotel explanations without mixing Q1/FY periods or stock-split EPS bases.

review_questions.future_review: When new public results arrive, compare total and segment measures with the explicitly corresponding period, entity and accounting basis; retain changes in scope and labels. A new cumulative quarter is not a same-duration Q1 or a full-year outcome.
review_questions.do_not_infer: No annualization, normal margins, sustainable CF, financial model fit or buy/sell condition from this Q1.

review_questions.future_review: Compare a new issuer forecast with the frozen issuer version and target period; preserve changes/unchanged wording and the split/average-share convention before comparing EPS. Keep issuer guidance separate from future actual and any external forecast.
review_questions.do_not_infer: No independent EPS forecast, probability, forward valuation or division/multiplication of split-adjusted EPS a second time.

review_questions.established_scope: Statement4 already describes construction and hotel segment sales/profit increases. Aggregate segment figures do not establish detailed cost/mix recognition, duration of labor/material effects or cash conversion.

limited_prior_reading.HTML: Saved issuer homepage and (1866 only) earnings index navigation/current acquisition snapshot only; no full linked-site review or renewed live freshness.
